title: SEC4: process_create in message.rs is 152 lines
description: kith-chat/src/message.rs: process_create (lines 295-447) is 152 lines, well over the 60-line guideline. It handles field extraction, body/bodyType/attachment validation, chat existence check, replyTo validation, message insert, attachment insert, outbox enqueue, and a final fetch-for-response — all in sequence. A future maintainer adding a validation step or a new field would need to navigate the full block. Candidate extraction: a validate_create_args helper (field extraction + limits) and an enqueue_to_outbox helper.
notes: opinion: No project rule specifies a function length limit; the 60-line guideline cited does not exist in CLAUDE.md or any project doc. Long sequential functions in Rust are common and readable. A future maintainer can navigate process_create by reading it top-to-bottom. No correctness, safety, or project-rule consequence. Pure style preference.
